mapper.insert: insert into vqms_regulation_stats (stat_grain, stat_period, entity_id, algorithm_id, total_cmds, qualified_fast, penalized_fast, exempted_fast, invalid_fast, qualified_econ, penalized_econ, exempted_econ, invalid_econ, undecodable_count, pended_count, excluded_count, completeness_sum, recompute_at) select 'D', stat_date, entity_id, case when count(distinct algorithm_id) = 1 then max(algorithm_id) else 'MIXED' end, count(*), sum(fast_state = 'QUALIFIED'), sum(fast_state = 'PENALIZED'), sum(fast_state = 'EXEMPTED'), sum(fast_state = 'INVALID'), sum(econ_state = 'QUALIFIED'), sum(econ_state = 'PENALIZED'), sum(econ_state = 'EXEMPTED'), sum(econ_state = 'INVALID'), sum(undecodable_reason is not null), 0, 0, sum(completeness), sysdate() from vqms_regulation_cmd where stat_date between #{start} and #{end} group by stat_date, entity_id on duplicate key update algorithm_id = values(algorithm_id), total_cmds = values(total_cmds), qualified_fast = values(qualified_fast), penalized_fast = values(penalized_fast), exempted_fast = values(exempted_fast), invalid_fast = values(invalid_fast), qualified_econ = values(qualified_econ), penalized_econ = values(penalized_econ), exempted_econ = values(exempted_econ), invalid_econ = values(invalid_econ), undecodable_count = values(undecodable_count), completeness_sum = values(completeness_sum), recompute_at = values(recompute_at)

insert into vqms_regulation_stats (stat_grain, stat_period, entity_id, algorithm_id, total_cmds, qualified_fast, penalized_fast, exempted_fast, invalid_fast, qualified_econ, penalized_econ, exempted_econ, invalid_econ, undecodable_count, pended_count, excluded_count, completeness_sum, recompute_at) select 'M', date_format(stat_period, '%Y-%m-01'), entity_id, case when count(distinct algorithm_id) = 1 then max(algorithm_id) else 'MIXED' end, sum(total_cmds), sum(qualified_fast), sum(penalized_fast), sum(exempted_fast), sum(invalid_fast), sum(qualified_econ), sum(penalized_econ), sum(exempted_econ), sum(invalid_econ), sum(undecodable_count), sum(pended_count), sum(excluded_count), sum(completeness_sum), sysdate() from vqms_regulation_stats where stat_grain = 'D' and stat_period >= date_format(#{monthStart}, '%Y-%m-01') and stat_period < date_format(#{monthStart}, '%Y-%m-01') + interval 1 month group by date_format(stat_period, '%Y-%m-01'), entity_id on duplicate key update algorithm_id = values(algorithm_id), total_cmds = values(total_cmds), qualified_fast = values(qualified_fast), penalized_fast = values(penalized_fast), exempted_fast = values(exempted_fast), invalid_fast = values(invalid_fast), qualified_econ = values(qualified_econ), penalized_econ = values(penalized_econ), exempted_econ = values(exempted_econ), invalid_econ = values(invalid_econ), undecodable_count = values(undecodable_count), completeness_sum = values(completeness_sum), recompute_at = values(recompute_at)

insert into vqms_regulation_stats (stat_grain, stat_period, entity_id, algorithm_id, total_cmds, qualified_fast, penalized_fast, exempted_fast, invalid_fast, qualified_econ, penalized_econ, exempted_econ, invalid_econ, undecodable_count, pended_count, excluded_count, completeness_sum, recompute_at) select 'Y', date_format(stat_period, '%Y-01-01'), entity_id, case when count(distinct algorithm_id) = 1 then max(algorithm_id) else 'MIXED' end, sum(total_cmds), sum(qualified_fast), sum(penalized_fast), sum(exempted_fast), sum(invalid_fast), sum(qualified_econ), sum(penalized_econ), sum(exempted_econ), sum(invalid_econ), sum(undecodable_count), sum(pended_count), sum(excluded_count), sum(completeness_sum), sysdate() from vqms_regulation_stats where stat_grain = 'M' and stat_period >= date_format(#{yearStart}, '%Y-01-01') and stat_period < date_format(#{yearStart}, '%Y-01-01') + interval 1 year group by date_format(stat_period, '%Y-01-01'), entity_id on duplicate key update algorithm_id = values(algorithm_id), total_cmds = values(total_cmds), qualified_fast = values(qualified_fast), penalized_fast = values(penalized_fast), exempted_fast = values(exempted_fast), invalid_fast = values(invalid_fast), qualified_econ = values(qualified_econ), penalized_econ = values(penalized_econ), exempted_econ = values(exempted_econ), invalid_econ = values(invalid_econ), undecodable_count = values(undecodable_count), completeness_sum = values(completeness_sum), recompute_at = values(recompute_at)
mapper.select: select id, stat_grain, stat_period, entity_id, algorithm_id, total_cmds, qualified_fast, penalized_fast, exempted_fast, invalid_fast, qualified_econ, penalized_econ, exempted_econ, invalid_econ, undecodable_count, pended_count, excluded_count, completeness_sum from vqms_regulation_stats where stat_grain = #{grain} and stat_period >= #{start} and stat_period <= #{end} order by stat_period
